description: POST a URL of an x402 paid endpoint, or a raw PAYMENT-REQUIRED header or 402 JSON body. Returns PASS/WARN/FAIL checks for x402 v1/v2 (header/version, CAIP-2 network, USDC asset, atomic amount, payTo, timeouts, EIP-712) plus optional live checks when url is set: facilitator /supported lists network+scheme, MCP tools/call challenge matches HTTP, and bad input returns charged:false before payment. Each failed check states payment impact (blocks_payment, client_specific, or cosmetic). $0.01. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].

live.description: Run facilitator/MCP/bad-input live checks when url is set (default true)

mcpTool.description: Optional MCP tool name (default from path)
